correctness.rationale: For primitive alpha, every m consecutive parity-check columns form a basis; fixed length-l shortened subspaces have size 2^(l-m). For b>n/2, each subfull-weight nonzero codeword has a unique zero run of length>=b, giving a unique complementary support arc. Endpoints-one inclusion-exclusion yields exact 1,1,2,4,... anchored counts and b-weight b+l-1; total count and subtraction give the polynomial. Independently coded direct window checks exhaust m=3,4 and independent anchored-span counts through m=5. No limiting or probabilistic step is used.

value.rationale: An infinite family of classical cyclic error-correcting codes gains a complete exact b-symbol enumerator in an otherwise nontrivial wide-window regime; geometric multiplicities and their cutoff are invisible to the previously known minimum-weight hierarchy and stability theorem. The result gives explicit probabilities of observing each window weight for uniform codewords and an exact count of all words below full read-channel weight. The selection b>n/2 is the mathematically natural threshold that makes a long zero run unique, rather than an arbitrary numeric slice.
